top_signals.title: Polymarket Wagers on Bank Failures Trigger FDIC Concerns
top_signals.summary: Polymarket bets on the likelihood that some of the biggest names in banking, including Wells Fargo & Co., JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Bank of America Corp., will fail are drawing scrutiny from officials in Washington, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: US Sanctions Are Stifling Cuban Economic Reform Efforts, Minister Says
top_signals.summary: Cuba Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Carlos Fernández De Cossío says sanctions are hobbling the island’s efforts to overhaul its economy and embrace capitalist reforms. He also acknowledges that people in Cuba are hoping political change in Washington might ease pressure on the island. Speaking with David Gura, De Cossío says, “if the US eases the amount of pressure, then those transformations in Cuba can go a long way and become truly irreversible, which is our aim and in theory is what the US wants to happen.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
